description: Complete pinned Integration module for the selected account. Offline coverage only; live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.77 remains open.

evidence.note: Select complete fetch_url as fetchUrl with required app, both optional nonnull response URL strings, cPanel 54 and ordinary Flag outcome. Source GET x-readonly:false/x-rollback:none selects effective form POST under existing policy; no live POST acceptance is established.
Retain formally required app:string as an application selector, preserving exact bytes including empty without validation or normalization; encode once in form body, not the routing query.

notes.text: Available from cPanel 54. Source GET explicitly declares x-readonly:false and x-rollback:none. Effective form POST follows existing mutation policy; all operation parameters are in the body and only routing stays in the URL.

app is the required application name string. Empty, whitespace, Unicode, percent, ampersand and plus bytes remain supplied and encode once. Optional redirect_url is the documented primary public redirect; url is the documented fallback if the primary is unavailable. Preserve both optional strings and empty values without local URL validation, navigation or automatic fallback.

One invocation makes one immediate request on the selected account through direct or WHM-bridged UAPI, with ordinary Flag outcome. Selectors are lazy and cached without I/O or metadata reset. No implicit rendering, HTML/script evaluation, URL navigation/fetch/fallback, local file access, path normalization, extra request, cache of server data, retry or rollback.

Data is a required nonnull object with optional known fields; empty objects are valid, absent data or explicit null mismatches. Existing empty JSON array object compatibility and unknown-field filtering remain unchanged. UAPI status 0 and outer WHM failures still throw before payload validation. Inspect responseMeta() warnings and raw metadata, including after a mismatch.

Inputs are ordinary noncredential selectors; returned content, paths, URLs and metadata may be private. Existing SensitiveParameter protections cover library-owned response frames, not caller-readable payloads, mismatch payloads or third-party transport traces. Offline fixtures establish no server acceptance, live UI/session behavior or POST compatibility; live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.77 remains open.
